items.uz: Muzliklarning erishi dengiz sathining ko'tarilishiga sabab bo'lmoqda.
items.en: The melting of glaciers is causing sea levels to rise.

items.uz: Issiqxona gazlari atmosferada to'planib bormoqda.
items.en: Greenhouse gases are accumulating in the atmosphere.

items.uz: Bu hodisa ekotizimlarga jiddiy zarar yetkazmoqda.
items.en: This phenomenon is causing serious damage to ecosystems.

items.uz: Ko'plab davlatlar uglerod chiqindilarini kamaytirishga harakat qilmoqda.
items.en: Many countries are trying to reduce carbon emissions.

items.uz: Iqlim o'zgarishi qishloq xo'jaligiga ham ta'sir ko'rsatmoqda.
items.en: Climate change is also affecting agriculture.

items.uz: Quyosh va shamol energiyasi muqobil manba sifatida rivojlanmoqda.
items.en: Solar and wind energy are developing as alternative sources.

items.uz: Bu muammoni hal qilish uchun xalqaro hamkorlik zarur.
items.en: International cooperation is necessary to solve this problem.

items.uz: Tabiiy ofatlarning tez-tez sodir bo'lishi iqlim o'zgarishi bilan bog'liq.
items.en: The frequent occurrence of natural disasters is related to climate change.

items.uz: Yer yuzasidagi harorat asta-sekin ko'tarilmoqda.
items.en: The Earth's surface temperature is gradually rising.

items.uz: Bu masala kelgusi avlodlar taqdiriga bevosita ta'sir qiladi.
items.en: This issue directly affects the fate of future generations.

items.uz: Chiqindilarni kamaytirish har birimizning vazifamiz.
items.en: Reducing waste is each of our responsibilities.

items.uz: Ilmiy dalillar bu muammoning jiddiyligini tasdiqlaydi.
items.en: Scientific evidence confirms the seriousness of this problem.

items.uz: U yigirma yoshida o'z biznesini boshladi.
items.en: He/she started his/her own business at the age of twenty.

items.uz: Muvaffaqiyatli tadbirkor xavf-xatarni oldindan hisoblab chiqadi.
items.en: A successful entrepreneur calculates risks in advance.

items.uz: Bu g'oya kutilmaganda katta foyda keltirdi.
items.en: This idea unexpectedly brought great profit.

items.uz: Startapning dastlabki bosqichi eng qiyin davr hisoblanadi.
items.en: The initial stage of a startup is considered the hardest period.

items.uz: Tadbirkorlar doimo yangi imkoniyatlarni izlaydi.
items.en: Entrepreneurs always seek new opportunities.

items.uz: Bu kompaniya nol asosda tashkil topgan.
items.en: This company was founded from scratch.

items.uz: Muvaffaqiyat sabr va qat'iyat talab qiladi.
items.en: Success requires patience and determination.

items.uz: Investorlar bu loyihaga ishonch bildirishdi.
items.en: Investors expressed confidence in this project.

items.uz: Har bir muvaffaqiyatsizlik yangi saboq beradi.
items.en: Every failure teaches a new lesson.

items.uz: Bu tadbirkor o'z jamoasini mohirona boshqaradi.
items.en: This entrepreneur skillfully manages his/her team.

items.uz: Yangi bozorga kirish katta jasorat talab qiladi.
items.en: Entering a new market requires great courage.

items.uz: Tadbirkorlik ruhi yoshlar orasida kuchayib bormoqda.
items.en: The entrepreneurial spirit is growing among young people.
